items.title: Leslie Johnson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2007
items.q: Max Morath play out there, who has become an extremely close friend, a dear, dear man.

ctx.x: Do you remember the first time that you saw a really good jazz band live?

I honestly did not see a jazz band live until I was an adult, and it was at the Emporium of Jazz in Mendota, which was the jazz mecca for the Twin Cities. And I remember going out and seeing Max Morath play out there, who has become an extremely close friend, a dear, dear man. Max is just a phenomenon as far as I’m concerned, there’s nobody like Max. I would love to see him here at IAJE doing a talk on Ragtime and popular culture. He is absolutely the ultimate entertainer. There is no one comes close to Max as…
